stem: In paragraph 2 of the selection “Rewards for Recycling,” what opinion does the author use to explain why some people do not recycle?

options.label: B
options.text: In some places, plastic, paper, glass, and metal can all go in the same bin.

options.label: C
options.text: In other places, each material must go in its own bin.

options.label: D
options.text: Many cities and neighborhoods have their own ways of collecting recycling.
